title: C desync: undefined macros break build; LISTEN/REJOIN timers absent
description: DIVERGENT + BUILD-BREAKING. Req 2a.6.3 timing parameters: LISTEN_PERIOD_MIN_S=30, LISTEN_PERIOD_MAX_S=60, DELAY_PER_NODE_S=5, MAX_STARTUP_DELAY_S=300, BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3, REJOIN_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=10, GUARD_PPM=5000. Evidence: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:156 references LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES and lichen/subsys/lichen/link/recovery_countdown.c:122-123 references LICHEN_T_DRIFT_MAX_SUPERFRAMES / LICHEN_T_GIVE_UP_SUPERFRAMES but NO #define exists anywhere in-tree (gcc -fsyntax-only -DCONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA=1 on tdma.c fails on undeclared identifier). GUARD_PPM=5000 exists (LICHEN_DRIFT_MAX_HOLDOVER_PPM 5000U link.h:656, drift_bound.c) and BEACON_TIMEOUT=3 via Kconfig (link/Kconfig:215-224). LISTEN_PERIOD 30/60, startup delay 5s/node cap 300s, REJOIN_TIMEOUT 10 superframes: absent from C (only recovery-countdown doc defaults). Suggested placement: add #defines to link.h (or Kconfig ints) for the three undefined macros (values 3/6/10 per comments and recovery_countdown.h:81-82), add LISTEN/STARTUP timing constants per 2a.6.3 table. Verify with ctest desync_fsm + tdma_guard_budget.
